policies.title: Admin endpoints check the caller's role
policies.statement: Every endpoint tagged admin calls the role-check function as its first statement, passing the logged-in user. The function must allow only the admin and support_lead roles: this rule confirms the call is first, not what the function decides. An endpoint without the admin tag is not examined, so every endpoint under /admin needs that tag. Advisory: a finding flags the endpoint and blocks nothing.

warnings.text: tags "admin" is on no query on this branch, so it selects nothing.
Function "require_admin" is not on this branch, so it never satisfies this rule.

policies.title: Tenant queries filter by org_id
policies.statement: Every read and write of the tenants table filters on org_id, so no query returns or changes tenants outside the filter. The rule reads each endpoint's and function's own statements; a helper function that reads tenants by a passed-in id is reported on that function. Advisory: a finding flags the object and blocks nothing.
